mapper.select: SELECT id FROM nw_knowledge_bases WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{kb} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_knowledge_index_projection_holds(id,tenant_id,kb_id,source_version,status) SELECT #{id},tenant_id,kb_id,source_version,'PENDING' FROM nw_knowledge_document_versions WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND kb_id=#{kb} AND source_version=#{source} AND status='ready'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM nw_knowledge_index_projection_holds WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_knowledge_index_projection_holds SET status='UNKNOWN' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'
mapper.select: WITH candidates AS (SELECT tenant_id,kb_id,source_version FROM nw_knowledge_index_cleanup_intents WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND next_attempt_at<=now() AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until<now()) ORDER BY next_attempt_at,kb_id,source_version LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) UPDATE nw_knowledge_index_cleanup_intents i SET lease_until=now()+interval '60 seconds',attempt=i.attempt+1 FROM candidates c WHERE i.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND i.kb_id=c.kb_id AND i.source_version=c.source_version RETURNING i.kb_id,i.source_version,i.attempt
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM nw_knowledge_index_cleanup_intents WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND kb_id=#{kb} AND source_version=#{source} AND attempt=#{attempt}
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_knowledge_index_cleanup_intents SET lease_until=NULL,next_attempt_at=now()+interval '60 seconds' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND kb_id=#{kb} AND source_version=#{source} AND attempt=#{attempt}
